debug.description: Enable verbose debug logging to stdout.

disable_ssl_verification.description: Disable SSL/TLS certificate verification (⚠️ insecure — only for testing).

inline_services.description: Advanced: Custom YAML-based service definitions (e.g., for plugins or extended config).

config.description: Key-value config for the inline service.

log_level.description: Logging verbosity. Recommended: `info` for production; `debug` only for troubleshooting.

retry_attempts.description: Number of times to retry sending a failed notification.

services.description: List of notification services (URLs) to use for sending alerts.

tags.description: Optional tags to group or target this service.
Named tag definitions for grouping services (e.g., `{ 'prod': 'Production alerts', 'dev': 'Dev/test alerts' }`).

timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for each notification request.

webhook_defaults.description: Default HTTP settings for webhook-based services (e.g., `content_type`, `method`).
